title: Encounter
description: The ```encounter block in a prepared encounter file (campaigns/<c>/dm/combat/encounters/<name>.md), read by `combat.py setup` and checked by `combat.py encounter check`. Paths are relative to the campaign folder unless they start with library/ or campaigns/.

title.description: Short name, e.g. 'Ambush at the ford'.

map.description: Map file, e.g. dm/combat/maps/ford.txt (may carry 'ambient:' and a 'light:' block).

blank.description: A blank grid instead of a map, e.g. '12x8'.

light.description: Ambient light; overrides the map file's 'ambient:'.

lights.description: Light sources and darkness: at a square, or carried by a token.

kind.description: torch, lantern kinds, sunrod, candle, light, daylight, darkness, …

pcs.description: The PCs, explicitly. Leave out to place every sheet in players/characters/ on pc_start.

pc_start.description: Start squares for the PCs (in sheet order), when 'pcs' is left out. setup --place C=E5 overrides.

token.description: e.g. g1; with count, a one-letter prefix (g → g1, g2, …).

count.description: Several identical creatures; pos is then a list.

name.description: Display name; with count, numbered (Goblin 1, Goblin 2).

ref.description: Stat block with a combat-profile block.

cr.description: CR for the XP summary, e.g. 1/3.

wielding.description: What it holds when the fight starts (an ambusher's bow), over its stat block's default.

tactics.description: This fight's personality and morale for the combatant, over its stat block's: {"weights": {…}, "morale": {…}} (see the system's combat-profile schema).

dm_plays.description: The main DM plays its turns (a boss, a story NPC with plans and dialogue). Default: the combat runner plays them.

surprise.description: The fight opens with a surprise round. true: the encounter's creatures ambush an unaware party (PCs and allies get no turn in it). Or {"unaware": [tokens, "party", "enemies"]}. Adjust at the table with combat_surprise once the Perception checks are in.

tactics.description: How the enemies fight (DM only; shown by setup).

exit_ramp.description: How the fight can end without the PC dying.
